Medical history

Finasteride and Propecia tablets has been associated with causing low mood, depression, and suicidal thoughts. If your mood or mental wellbeing worsens while taking this medication, stop taking Finasteride or Propecia tablets and seek medical advice as soon as possible.

If you ever feel at risk of harming yourself or have seriously harmed yourself, call emergency services on 999 immediately.
